inputs: regions_bounds.wgsl's cs_bounds on regions.wgsl's seen and covered, over the regions fixture's frame: 16 × 16 px in 2D (page = [1, 0, 0, 1]), one side of look 0, one straight-edged box region of look 1, the 2D volume of rect@1 [4.25, 4, 8, 8]; the bounds start at [u32 max, u32 max, 0, 0] per look. A pixel counts for its region's look when clamp(0.5 − sd, 0, 1) > 0, sd = max(|x + 0.5 − 8.25| − 4, |y + 0.5 − 8| − 4) inside. Output: one row per look index (0..3), its words [x0, y0, x1, y1] as integer codes.

expect.why: y0 of look 1: row 4 has |4.5 − 8| − 4 = −0.5, m = 1 at x = 8; row 3 has 0.5 or more, m = 0
x1 of look 1: column 12 has sd = |12.5 − 8.25| − 4 = 0.25, m = 0.25 > 0; column 13 has sd = 1, m = 0
y1 of look 1: row 11 has |11.5 − 8| − 4 = −0.5, m = 1 at x = 8; row 12 has 0.5 or more, m = 0
look 0 is the side's own look with no region of it: its x0 and y0 keep their start, u32 max
look 0's x1 and y1 keep their start, 0
looks 2 and 3 aren't in the frame: their x0 and y0 keep their start, u32 max
looks 2 and 3's x1 and y1 keep their start, 0
